walkthrough.title: Get Started with Tcl Tools
walkthrough.description: A short tour: interpreter, running, tests and debugging.
walkthrough.step.interpreter.title: 1. Pick an interpreter
walkthrough.step.interpreter.description:
Choose the `tclsh` used to run, debug and learn your commands.
[Select Interpreter](command:tcl.selectInterpreter)
walkthrough.step.environment.title: 2. Check your environment
walkthrough.step.environment.description:
See which interpreter is used and whether introspection works.
[Show Environment Info](command:tcl.showEnvironment)
walkthrough.step.sample.title: 3. Try the sample file
walkthrough.step.sample.description:
Open a small file with completion, hover and a diagnostic to look at.
[Open Sample File](command:tcl.openWalkthroughSample)
walkthrough.step.run.title: 4. Run a script
walkthrough.step.run.description:
Run the current file in a terminal.
[Run Current File](command:tcl.runFile)
walkthrough.step.tests.title: 5. Run tests
walkthrough.step.tests.description:
tcltest cases show up in the Testing view.
[Open Testing View](command:workbench.view.testing.focus)
walkthrough.step.debug.title: 6. Debug a script
walkthrough.step.debug.description:
Set a breakpoint and press F5.
[Start Debugging](command:workbench.action.debug.start)
walkthrough.step.projectConfig.title: 7. Describe host commands (optional)
walkthrough.step.projectConfig.descripti:
For Vivado, Quartus or your own framework.
[Create Project Config](command:tcl.createProjectConfig)
walkthrough.step.next.title: 8. Where to go next
walkthrough.step.next.description:
